query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS push_ab_tests (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  testName VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active',
  variantA_title TEXT NOT NULL,
  variantA_body TEXT NOT NULL,
  variantB_title TEXT NOT NULL,
  variantB_body TEXT NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'custom',
  url TEXT,
  variantA_sent INT DEFAULT 0,
  variantA_opened INT DEFAULT 0,
  variantB_sent INT DEFAULT 0,
  variantB_opened INT DEFAULT 0,
  winner VARCHAR(1),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  completedAt TIMESTAMP NULL
);
